004906: BUSTER_C_SHARED u32 c_integer_msvc_literal_width(String8 spelling, bool* is_unsigned)
004907: {
004908:     u32 width = 0;
004909:     for (u32 length = 2; !width && length <= 3 && length <= spelling.length; length += 1)

004915:             *is_unsigned = start && (spelling.pointer[start - 1] == 'u' || spelling.pointer[start - 1] == 'U');
004916:         }
004917:     }
004918:     return width;
004919: }

004921: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_integer_suffix_valid(String8 suffix)
004922: {
004923:     bool valid = !suffix.length;
004924:     if (suffix.length)
004925:     {
004926:         bool first_unsigned = suffix.pointer[0] == 'u' || suffix.pointer[0] == 'U';
004927:         bool first_long = suffix.pointer[0] == 'l' || suffix.pointer[0] == 'L';
004928:         if (c_integer_msvc_suffix_width(suffix))
004929:         {
004930:             valid = true;
004931:         }
004932:         else if (suffix.length == 1)
004933:         {
004934:             valid = first_unsigned || first_long;
004935:         }
004936:         else if (suffix.length == 2 || suffix.length == 3)
004937:         {
004938:             bool second_unsigned = suffix.pointer[1] == 'u' || suffix.pointer[1] == 'U';
004939:             bool second_long = suffix.pointer[1] == 'l' || suffix.pointer[1] == 'L';
004940:             bool long_pair = first_long && second_long && suffix.pointer[0] == suffix.pointer[1];
004941:             if (suffix.length == 2)
004942:             {
004943:                 valid = long_pair || (first_unsigned && second_long) || (first_long && second_unsigned);
004944:             }
004945:             else
004946:             {
004947:                 bool third_unsigned = suffix.pointer[2] == 'u' || suffix.pointer[2] == 'U';
004948:                 bool third_long = suffix.pointer[2] == 'l' || suffix.pointer[2] == 'L';

004950:                         (long_pair && third_unsigned);
004951:             }
004952:         }
004953:     }
004954:     return valid;
004955: }

004957: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_integer_digit(u8 byte)
004958: {
004959:     u32 digit = UINT32_MAX;
004960:     if (byte >= '0' && byte <= '9')
004961:     {
004962:         digit = (u32)(byte - '0');
004963:     }
004964:     else if (byte >= 'a' && byte <= 'f')
004965:     {
004966:         digit = (u32)(byte - 'a') + 10;
004967:     }
004968:     else if (byte >= 'A' && byte <= 'F')
004969:     {
004970:         digit = (u32)(byte - 'A') + 10;
004971:     }
004972:     return digit;
004973: }

004975: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_conditional_number(String8 spelling, u64* value)
004976: {
004977:     u32 base = 10;
004978:     u64 index = 0;
004979:     if (spelling.length >= 2 && spelling.pointer[0] == '0')
004980:     {
004981:         if (spelling.pointer[1] == 'x' || spelling.pointer[1] == 'X')
004982:         {
004983:             base = 16;
004984:             index = 2;
004985:         }
004986:         else if (spelling.pointer[1] == 'b' || spelling.pointer[1] == 'B')
004987:         {
004988:             base = 2;
004989:             index = 2;
004990:         }
004991:         else
004992:         {
004993:             base = 8;
004994:         }
004995:     }
004996:     u64 parsed = 0;
004997:     u64 cutoff = UINT64_MAX / base;
004998:     u32 last_digit = (u32)(UINT64_MAX % base);
004999:     bool any = false;
005000:     bool valid = true;
005001:     while (valid && index < spelling.length)
005002:     {
005003:         u8 byte = spelling.pointer[index];
005004:         if (byte == '\'')
005005:         {
005006:             // A separator joins two digits of this base, never a prefix or
005007:             // suffix. Checking the next byte also rejects consecutive quotes.
005008:             valid = any && index + 1 < spelling.length && c_integer_digit(spelling.pointer[index + 1]) < base;
005009:             index += 1;
005010:         }
005011:         else
005012:         {
005013:             u32 digit = c_integer_digit(byte);
005014:             if (digit >= base)
005015:             {
005016:                 break;
005017:             }
005018:             valid = parsed < cutoff || (parsed == cutoff && digit <= last_digit);
005019:             if (valid)
005020:             {
005021:                 parsed = parsed * base + digit;
005022:                 any = true;
005023:                 index += 1;
005024:             }
005025:         }
005026:     }
005027:     valid = valid && any && c_integer_suffix_valid((String8){.pointer = spelling.pointer + index, .length = spelling.length - index});
005028:     if (valid)
005029:     {
005030:         *value = parsed;
005031:     }
005032:     return valid;
005033: }

005035: // C11 6.10.1p4: conditional-inclusion arithmetic uses intmax_t or
005036: // uintmax_t. Keep signedness and deferred arithmetic faults in the existing
005037: // one-byte-per-value sidecar. Reductions still validate every operand's syntax,
005038: // but &&, || and ?: discard faults from operands they do not evaluate.
005039: // A fault always follows an evaluated condition/left operand, even when its
005040: // placeholder value makes a later logical expression appear to succeed.
005041: enum
005042: {
005043:     C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED = 1,
005044:     C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT = 2,
005045: };
005046: 
005047: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_conditional_apply(CConditionalOperator operation, u64* values, u8* value_flags, u32* value_count)
005048: {
005049:     bool valid = true;
005050:     if (c_conditional_is_unary(operation))
005051:     {
005052:         if (!*value_count)
005053:         {
005054:             valid = false;
005055:         }
005056:         else
005057:         {
005058:             u32 index = *value_count - 1;
005059:             u64* value = values + index;
005060:             switch (operation)
005061:             {
005062:             case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS:
005063:                 break;
005064:             case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS:
005065:                 *value = 0 - *value;
005066:                 break;
005067:             case C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_NOT:
005068:                 *value = !*value;
005069:                 value_flags[index] &= C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT;
005070:                 break;
005071:             case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT:
005072:                 *value = ~*value;
005073:                 break;
005074:             default:
005075:                 valid = false;
005076:                 break;
005077:             }
005078:         }
005079:     }
005080:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SELECT)
005081:     {
005082:         if (*value_count < 3)
005083:         {
005084:             valid = false;
005085:         }
005086:         else
005087:         {
005088:             u64 false_value = values[--*value_count];
005089:             u8 false_flags = value_flags[*value_count];
005090:             u64 true_value = values[--*value_count];
005091:             u8 true_flags = value_flags[*value_count];
005092:             u32 index = *value_count - 1;
005093:             u64* condition = values + index;
005094:             u8 selected_flags = *condition ? true_flags : false_flags;
005095:             // Both arms determine the common type, but only the selected
005096:             // arm and the always-evaluated condition contribute faults.
005097:             value_flags[index] = (u8)(((true_flags | false_flags) & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED) |
005098:                                      ((value_flags[index] | selected_flags) & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT));
005099:             *condition = *condition ? true_value : false_value;
005100:         }
005101:     }
005102:     else if (*value_count < 2)
005103:     {
005104:         valid = false;
005105:     }
005106:     else
005107:     {
005108:         u64 right = values[--*value_count];
005109:         u8 right_flags = value_flags[*value_count];
005110:         u32 index = *value_count - 1;
005111:         u64* left = values + index;
005112:         u8 left_flags = value_flags[index];
005113:         u8 flags = (u8)(left_flags | right_flags);
005114:         bool mixed_unsigned = (flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED) != 0;
005115:         switch (operation)
005116:         {
005117:         case C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY:
005118:             *left *= right;
005119:             break;
005120:         case C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE:
005121:         case C_CONDITIONAL_REMAINDER:
005122:             // Never execute an invalid host division, even in a subtree
005123:             // whose fault will be discarded by an enclosing short circuit.
005124:             if ((flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT) || !right ||
005125:                 (!mixed_unsigned && (s64)*left == INT64_MIN && (s64)right == -1))
005126:             {
005127:                 flags |= C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT;
005128:                 *left = 0;
005129:             }
005130:             else if (mixed_unsigned)
005131:             {
005132:                 *left = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE ? *left / right : *left % right;
005133:             }
005134:             else
005135:             {
005136:                 *left = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE ? (u64)((s64)*left / (s64)right) : (u64)((s64)*left % (s64)right);
005137:             }
005138:             break;
005139:         case C_CONDITIONAL_ADD:
005140:             *left += right;
005141:             break;
005142:         case C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT:
005143:             *left -= right;
005144:             break;
005145:         case C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_LEFT:
005146:             *left = right < 64 ? *left << right : 0;
005147:             flags = (u8)((flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT) | (left_flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED));
005148:             break;
005149:         case C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_RIGHT:
005150:             if (left_flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED)
005151:             {
005152:                 *left = right < 64 ? *left >> right : 0;
005153:             }
005154:             else
005155:             {
